newsitem.title: USA: BPA raises non-firm shoulder hour power $2.50/MWh.
newsitem.headline: BPA raises non-firm shoulder hour power $2.50/MWh.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) raised prices for non-firm power during shoulder hours on Friday by $2.50 per megawatt hour (MWh) but left other prices unchanged, the federal agency said Thursday.
Non-firm shoulder hour (0600, 1100-1700 and 2100-2300 PST) prices for Friday were increased to $13.00 per MWh for Northwest sales and $14.00 for California-Oregon border (COB) deals.
BPA continued to refrain from offering non-firm power during morning and evening peaks or any displacement power.
BPA still offered up to 300 megawatts of firm peak power on Friday at $16.75 per MWh for Northwest sales and $17.75 for COB.
Prices for firm and non-firm power during off-peak hours on Thursday were unchanged at $9.00 per MWh for all deliveries.
